items.reason: Conditions name only glioblastoma, but inclusion admits 'primary or recurrent high-grade gliomas (HGG)', so several glioma types are eligible; gbm_only requires that only glioblastoma is eligible. Both values include the trial.

note: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Detailed description says the trial will 'focus on the role of posaconazole exclusively', but the registered arm, intervention and outcomes are ketoconazole only; coded per registered intervention. No D31 convention changes this record (C5: ketoconazole measured in microdialysis dialysate, tumour PK yes).
